description: Barcode lookup, nutrition search, and product comparison for 3M+ crowd-sourced food products.

tool_signatures.name: off_browse_taxonomy
tool_signatures.description: Browse and search the canonical tag vocabulary for Open Food Facts filter facets. Returns tag IDs and display names for use as filter values in off_search_products. Covers categories, labels/certifications, allergens, additives, countries, NOVA groups, and Nutri-Score grades. Tag IDs use the "en:" prefix convention (e.g. "en:organic", "en:gluten-free", "en:milk"). Use these tag IDs as filter values, not plain English terms.

facet.description: "categories" covers food categories (en:cheeses, en:breakfast-cereals). "labels" covers certifications (en:organic, en:fair-trade). "allergens" covers declared allergens (en:milk, en:gluten). "additives" covers E-numbers (en:e322). "countries" covers country-of-sale tags (en:france). "nova_groups" and "nutrition_grades" return the complete fixed vocabularies.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–100, default 20). The categories facet is broad; a search term narrows it to the relevant tags.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter against tag ID or display name. Example: "gluten" returns en:gluten, en:no-gluten. Omit to list all entries for the facet (may be large for categories).

id.description: Canonical tag ID (e.g. "en:organic"). Use this value in off_search_products filter parameters.

products.description: Approximate count of products with this tag. Not available for all facets.

items.description: A single taxonomy tag entry with its canonical ID and display name.

facet.description: The facet name that was queried (echoes the input).

truncated.description: True when more tags exist beyond the limit.

total_in_facet.description: Total entries in this facet before search filtering. Large for categories.

tool_signatures.name: off_compare_products
tool_signatures.description: Side-by-side nutrition and scoring comparison for 2–10 products by barcode. Returns a normalized table of energy (kcal/100g), fat, saturated fat, sugars, salt, protein, fiber, Nutri-Score, NOVA group, and Green-Score. Designed for "which of these cereals is healthiest?" or "compare these pasta brands" workflows. Missing nutrition data for any product is preserved as absent — comparisons are not imputed. Scores carry regional formula caveats. Data under ODbL 1.0 — cite Open Food Facts in downstream use.

barcodes.description: 2–10 barcodes to compare, returned as one row each in input order. Example: ["3017620422003", "7622210100146"].

found.description: False if the barcode has no contributor record.

brands.description: Brand name(s), comma-separated. Absent when not yet entered.

barcode.description: EAN-13 or UPC barcode (same as provided input).

fat_100g.description: Total fat per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

salt_100g.description: Salt per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

fiber_100g.description: Dietary fiber per 100g in grams. Often absent.

nova_group.description: NOVA processing class (1–4). Absent when not assigned.

sugars_100g.description: Total sugars per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

completeness.description: Data completeness 0–1. Low values mean many fields are missing.

product_name.description: Product name. Absent when not yet entered by contributors.

proteins_100g.description: Protein per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

energy_kcal_100g.description: Energy per 100g in kcal. Absent when not entered.

nutriscore_grade.description: Nutri-Score letter (a–e). Absent when not computed.

saturated_fat_100g.description: Saturated fat per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

products.description: Comparison rows, one per barcode in input order.

items.description: EAN-13 or UPC barcode with no contributor record.

not_found.description: Barcodes with no contributor record. Not an error — the product may exist but not yet entered in Open Food Facts.

succeeded.description: Number of barcodes that resolved to a found product.

tool_signatures.name: off_get_product
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a packaged food product by barcode (EAN-13 or UPC) from Open Food Facts. Returns the product name, brand, quantity, ingredients (raw text and parsed list), allergens, additives, computed scores (Nutri-Score a–e, NOVA 1–4, Green-Score), nutrition per 100g and per serving, categories, labels, packaging, origins, image URL, and data completeness. Open Food Facts is a crowd-sourced database — a missing field means "not yet entered by contributors," not that the attribute is absent from the actual product. Computed scores carry regional formula caveats and are indicators, not absolute rankings. Data is under ODbL 1.0 — cite Open Food Facts in downstream use.

items.description: A specific product field to include in the response.

fields.description: Subset of fields to return. Omitting returns all standard fields. Use to reduce payload when only scores or ingredients are needed.

barcode.description: EAN-13 or UPC barcode (8–14 digits). The primary key for Open Food Facts. Example: "3017620422003" (Nutella FR).

found.description: False when the barcode exists in no contributor record (status:0). A false result means no contributor has entered this product yet — not that the product does not exist.

barcode.description: Barcode as returned by the API.

quantity.description: Net quantity as printed on packaging (e.g. "400g").

nova_group.description: NOVA food processing class (1=unprocessed, 2=culinary ingredients, 3=processed, 4=ultra-processed). Absent when not enough data.

fiber_100g.description: Dietary fiber per 100g in grams. Often absent.

fat_serving.description: Total fat per serving in grams. Absent when serving size not defined.

sugars_serving.description: Sugars per serving in grams. Absent when serving size not defined.

energy_kcal_serving.description: Energy per serving in kcal. Absent when serving size not defined.

nutriments.description: Nutrition figures normalized to underscore keys. All values may be absent when nutrition data not yet entered.

text.description: Ingredient name as it appears in the list.

ingredients.description: Parsed ingredient list. Absent when not yet parsed by contributors.

labels_tags.description: Label/certification tag IDs. Absence means not yet entered.

completeness.description: Data completeness score from 0–1. Below 0.5 indicates many fields are missing.

origins_tags.description: Ingredient origin tag IDs. Frequently empty.

product_name.description: Product name. May be absent if not yet entered by contributors.

additives_tags.description: E-number additive tag IDs. Absence means not yet entered.

allergens_tags.description: Canonical allergen tag IDs. Absence means not yet entered — not that the product is allergen-free.

ecoscore_grade.description: Green-Score/Eco-Score environmental impact letter (a–e, or "unknown"). Highly variable — depends on packaging, origins, and transport data completeness.

packaging_tags.description: Packaging material tag IDs. Often absent.

categories_tags.description: Category tag IDs in canonical form. Use as filter values for off_search_products.

ingredients_text.description: Raw ingredients text from the label, in the source language.

nutriscore_grade.description: Nutri-Score letter (a–e, lowercase). "a" is highest nutritional quality. Absent when not enough nutrition data to compute. Regional formula variants exist.

data_quality_tags.description: Crowd-sourced data quality flags. Absence means not yet checked.

product.description: Product data. Absent when found is false.

items.description: A field name from the requested subset.

requested_fields.description: The field subset that was requested, when the caller passed `fields`. Absent means all standard fields were requested. Sections outside this subset are omitted because they were not requested — not because Open Food Facts lacks the data.

tool_signatures.name: off_search_products
tool_signatures.description: Search Open Food Facts by full-text query, structured tag filters, or both at once. Returns a summary list with barcodes, product names, brands, Nutri-Score, NOVA group, and categories — enough for triage and selection, not full label data. Use off_get_product on the returned barcodes for complete details. A text query and tag filters combine: results match the query text and satisfy every filter provided (e.g. query "dark chocolate" with labels_tag "en:organic" and countries_tag "en:france" returns organic chocolate sold in France). Tag filter values must be canonical tag IDs (e.g. "en:organic", "en:gluten-free") — use off_browse_taxonomy to resolve human terms to tag IDs. At least one search parameter is required. Data is crowd-sourced; result count reflects contributed products, not all products in the market. Data under ODbL 1.0 — cite Open Food Facts in downstream use.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Use with page_size to paginate results.

query.description: Full-text search term across product names, brands, and ingredients. Combines with any tag filters — results match this text and satisfy the filters. Example: "dark chocolate 70%".

sort_by.description: Sort order for searches without a text query. "unique_scans_n" surfaces the most-scanned products; omitting returns results in default order. Searches that include a text query are relevance-ranked and ignore this option.

page_size.description: Results per page (1–50, default 20). Keep low for initial exploration; increase for comparison workflows.

brands_tag.description: Brand slug (lowercased, hyphenated). Example: "nutella", "kelloggs". Fuzzy — partial matches may work.

labels_tag.description: Canonical label/certification tag ID. Example: "en:organic", "en:fair-trade", "en:no-gluten". Use off_browse_taxonomy with facet="labels".

nova_group.description: Filter by NOVA food processing class. "1"=unprocessed/minimally processed, "4"=ultra-processed. Products without a NOVA score are excluded.

countries_tag.description: Canonical country tag ID. Example: "en:france", "en:united-states". Filters to products sold in that country.

categories_tag.description: Canonical category tag ID. Example: "en:breakfast-cereals", "en:cheeses". Use off_browse_taxonomy with facet="categories" to discover valid values.

nutrition_grade.description: Filter by Nutri-Score grade. "a" is highest nutritional quality, "e" is lowest. Products without a score are excluded.

shown.description: Number of products returned on this page.

total.description: Total matching products in the database for this query.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty — echoes filters and suggests how to broaden.

brands.description: Brand name(s), comma-separated. Absent when not yet entered.

barcode.description: EAN/UPC barcode. Pass to off_get_product for full details.

nova_group.description: NOVA processing class (1–4). Absent when not assigned.

product_name.description: Product name. May be absent for incompletely entered products.

ecoscore_grade.description: Green-Score letter (a–e). Environmental impact indicator. Absent when not computed.

categories_tags.description: Category tag IDs in canonical form. Use as filter values for off_search_products.

nutriscore_grade.description: Nutri-Score letter (a–e). Absent when not computed.

items.description: A single matching product summary row.

products.description: Matching products. Use barcodes with off_get_product for full label data.

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

page_count.description: Products returned on this page (mirrors page_size except on the last page). Not the total number of pages.
